item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Diwash 👋

I’m a Software Engineer at Bhoos Games (3 years), building cross-platform mobile apps and card games with React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js.

I led engineering for Callbreak Legend (1M+ downloads), designed an IAP system that made it profitable, and migrated production databases from DynamoDB to PostgreSQL with zero downtime.

Previously, I contributed 50+ pull requests to the Python Software Foundation during Google Summer of Code 2022.
